test.query: SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(materialize(repeat('value=£,x=€,🙂;', 1) || 'xxxxxxxxxxx')))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(materialize(repeat('value=£,x=€,🙂;', 3) || 'xxxx')))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(materialize(repeat('value=£,x=€,🙂;', 6) || 'xxxxxxx')))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(materialize(concat('\xFF', substring(repeat('€£🙂', 7), 2)))))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
WITH concat(repeat('€£🙂', 28), 'xxxx') AS s SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(materialize(concat(substring(s, 1, 40), '\xFF', substring(s, 42)))))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(length(toValidUTF8(concat(repeat('x', number % 32), 'é中文🙂', repeat('z', number % 17))))) AS total FROM numbers(1000000) FORMAT Null
